# Norns

> Norns saves each run’s progress so an agent can pick up after a worker disconnects or Norns restarts. It is open source under the MIT license.

The Norns server, written in Elixir, records events and sends tasks to workers over WebSocket. Your workers make model calls, run tools, and keep the API keys. Python and Elixir SDKs are available, and workers in other languages can use the documented protocol.

Norns rebuilds run state from the event log after a restart. If a worker disconnects, Norns can queue the pending task and resend it when another eligible worker connects. A resent task carries the same idempotency key. To prevent a duplicate external effect, the destination must honor that key. Norns supports a single node backed by Postgres.

A run can wait for a timer, a reply, or another agent. The event log records requests, responses, tool calls, retries, and replies. The run API can inspect those events, retry a run, or fork one from a past step. See the architecture and API spec for details.

## Project

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/nornscode/norns): Elixir orchestrator source
- [README](https://github.com/nornscode/norns#readme): Quickstart
- [Architecture](https://github.com/nornscode/norns/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): Orchestrator/worker split, worker protocol, event schema, agent states
- [Decision log](https://github.com/nornscode/norns/blob/main/docs/decision-log.md): What is built and why, with dates
- [Roadmap](https://github.com/nornscode/norns/blob/main/docs/roadmap.md): Sequencing and what is not being built
- [OpenAPI spec](https://github.com/nornscode/norns/blob/main/openapi.yaml): HTTP API surface

## SDKs

- [Python SDK](https://github.com/nornscode/norns-sdk-python): Worker and client library, `pip install norns-sdk`
- [Elixir SDK](https://github.com/nornscode/norns-sdk-elixir): Worker and client library, `{:norns_sdk, "~> 0.1"}`

## Tooling

- [nornsctl](https://github.com/nornscode/nornsctl): CLI for running a local orchestrator, scaffolding agent projects, and inspecting agents, runs and event logs

## Examples

- [Hello agent](https://github.com/nornscode/norns-hello-agent): Minimal worker
- [Mimir](https://github.com/nornscode/norns-mimir-agent): Answers project questions in Slack using connected repositories and pages
- [Fulla](https://github.com/nornscode/fulla): Sends reminders and follows up in chat. Each reminder waits in Norns while the worker can stop
- [Sleipnir](https://github.com/nornscode/sleipnir): Coding agent that other agents hand work to

## Install

```
brew install nornscode/tap/nornsctl
nornsctl dev
nornsctl new my-agent
cd my-agent
uv sync
uv run my-agent-worker
```
